mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM media_source WHERE password_encrypted IS NOT NULL
SELECT password_encrypted FROM media_source WHERE password_encrypted IS NOT NULL

where.if: (LOWER(name) LIKE LOWER(#{keyword}) ESCAPE '!' OR LOWER(location) LIKE LOWER(#{keyword}) ESCAPE '!')

mapper.select: SELECT source.id, source.name, source.source_type, source.location, source.username, source.password_encrypted, source.parser_profile_id, source.created_at, source.updated_at, source.scan_enabled, source.scan_cron, source.next_scan_at, source.last_scan_at, source.last_scan_status, source.last_scan_error FROM media_source source JOIN ( SELECT id, created_at FROM media_source ORDER BY created_at DESC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset} ) page_ids ON page_ids.id = source.id ORDER BY page_ids.created_at DESC, page_ids.id ASC
SELECT id, name FROM media_source WHERE parser_profile_id = #{profileId} ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE media_source SET updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND updated_at = #{expected}
UPDATE media_source SET scan_enabled=#{enabled}, scan_cron=#{cron}, next_scan_at=#{next} WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, scan_cron, next_scan_at FROM media_source WHERE scan_enabled=1 AND next_scan_at <= #{now} ORDER BY next_scan_at,id LIMIT 20
mapper.update: UPDATE media_source SET next_scan_at=#{next} WHERE id=#{id} AND scan_enabled=1 AND next_scan_at=#{expected}
UPDATE media_source SET last_scan_at=#{now}, last_scan_status=#{status}, last_scan_error=#{error} WHERE id=#{id}
